correctness.rationale: The stabilizer H has order q dividing 4; quotienting by H produces 4/q positive hypotheses at every query and n/q distinct translates. q=4 leaves one positive hypothesis so Ldim=1; q=2 gives exactly two positive and at least two negative, yielding depth 2 but forbidding 3. If q=1, every root positive branch contains four hypotheses and negative contains n-4>=4, forcing Ldim<=3 and >=2. To shatter depth three the four-element positive space must split 2/2 on its second query, equivalently a nonzero overlap lambda_A(t)=2. Conversely a split of size 2 yields all four second-level cells cardinalities 2,2,2,n-6>=2 and a third separating query in each, so Ldim=3. Explicit difference lists for A and overlap for B show the infinite equal-size contrast. Fresh independent recursion over actual Boolean incidence tables confirms all 1,231 four-subsets for n=8..12 and both n=15 witnesses. Finite tests do not establish n unbounded; analytic version-space argument does.

value.rationale: Complete all-n structural classification of a natural online-learning invariant for cyclic translate hypothesis classes. The criterion links adaptively shattered trees to one elementary autocorrelation multiplicity and distinguishes Sidon supports from intervals even when hypothesis count and support size agree.

final_claim: For each n>=8 and four-point A subset Z/n, put q=|{t:A+t=A}| and lambda_A(t)=|A cap(A+t)|. The Littlestone dimension of distinct translate indicators is 1 if q=4; 3 if q=1 and some t!=0 has lambda_A(t)=2; 2 otherwise. For all n>=15, Sidon A={0,1,3,7} and progression B={0,1,2,3} have the same n hypotheses of support four but dimensions 2 and 3.
limitations: Only four-point supports and cyclic groups n>=8; no claims about arbitrary support sizes, n<8, or full VC dimension classification.
